skillsAreInstructionsInSkillMd: Skills are instructions in SKILL.md files. Enable each one for the agents that should follow it in this company.
installAReadyMadeSkillInOneClick: Install a ready-made skill in one click.
skillsTheTeamWrote: Skills the team wrote. They go through the same check.

skillCouldNotBeChanged: The skill could not be saved. Try again.
skillProblemInstallScript: it runs a script when installed

skillProblemNoDescription: it has no description of up to 1,024 characters
skillProblemNoPermissions: it does not declare its permissions
skillProblemUnknownPermission: it declares a permission that does not exist
